about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Black River Action Team
channels.note: Black River Action Team: monitoring results. Voluntary monitoring; unreachable in the research. https://www.blackriveractionteam.org/ answered connection to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: Brandon
channels.legal_basis: 10 V.S.A. § 1295(b): the operator posts a public alert within 1 hour of discovery on the electronic media the Secretary designates (the DEC page); (e): a permanent sign at every CSO outfall
channels.note: Brandon: public alert on the DEC Sewage Overflows page. The operator's legal channel is the shared state page. Registry row built from the feed's facility name. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.1-2.3)

channels.name: Burlington Main WWTF combined sewer system (City of Burlington DPW Water Resources)
channels.note: Burlington CSO notices through VT-Alert. Voluntary city channel; VT-Alert also publishes a public RSS feed (found in the sign-up pass; URL not recorded). Sign-up status: needs_owner (docs/subscriptions.md). Covers: vt-burlington-dpw-main, vt-burlington-dpw-north, vt-burlington-dpw-east. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.2, §3)

channels.name: Connecticut River Conservancy
channels.note: Connecticut River Conservancy, Is It Clean? (VT tributaries). Voluntary; Black, White and Ottauquechee rivers. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: Vermont DEC
channels.legal_basis: 10 V.S.A. § 1295(b): public alert within 1 hour of discovery on the electronic media the Secretary designates; (c): 12-hour report via DEC's online event reporting system
channels.note: DEC Sewage Overflows page: public alerts and incident reports. Staff names and phone numbers appear in rows; dropped at ingest. Covers every operator in the state. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: Vermont DEC
channels.note: DEC Wastewater Notification Subscription System (email or text). Voluntary push beyond the designated page; needs an email-and-password account. Sign-up status: needs_owner (docs/subscriptions.md). Covers every operator in the state. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: Vermont DEC
channels.legal_basis: 10 V.S.A. § 1295(d): the Secretary posts other unpermitted discharges within 4 hours (by 10:00 a.m. if found overnight)
channels.note: DEC Unpermitted Discharges Public Report. Mostly fuel spills; some rows carry private addresses (store nothing personal). (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. . Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)

Covers every operator in the state. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.1, §2.4)
